reason: June 30, 2026 ends the annual allowable-increase period; the RSO does not expire then. end_date set to null and the period moved into key_value (rule 1). Citation now matches the document's wording.

rule.title: RSO annual allowable rent increase (July 2025 - June 2026)
rule.citation: City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
rule.requirement: For units covered by the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance, the yearly rent increase from July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026 is limited to 3%. Starting February 2, 2026, landlords can no longer add an extra percentage for utilities.
rule.requirement_es: Para las unidades cubiertas por la Ordenanza de Estabilización de Rentas de Los Ángeles, el aumento anual de renta del 1 de julio de 2025 al 30 de junio de 2026 está limitado al 3%. A partir del 2 de febrero de 2026, los arrendadores ya no pueden agregar un porcentaje adicional por servicios públicos.
rule.coverage_text: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).

applies_if.value_text: Unit is subject to the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)

rule.quote:
Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective
July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026
is
3%
